card: Adds wallet sending and RBF fee-bumping capabilities for BIP 352 silent payment destinations across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, sendall, and bumpfee. Currently, Bitcoin Core cannot send to silent payment addresses because output scripts cannot be derived in advance without input private keys and coin selection awareness. The PR introduces PaymentDestination, enforces derivation-eligible coin selection with accessible private keys, dynamically derives Taproot outputs, persists recipient metadata in the wallet database for RBF output recalculation, and restricts unsupported PSBT/external-signer operations. It is the second iteration of sending support tracked under #28536 and depends on #36962.
changed_since_previous: The PR has rebased onto prerequisite PR #36962 (replacing #35301 as the active open dependency) and incorporates refactors to feebumper error handling and change destination validation.
evidence: PR description: "This PR is part of integrating silent payments into Bitcoin Core. It is the second iteration of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/28201. Status and tracking for the project is managed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/28536"

PR commit 0a69cbd913: "When funding a silent payments transaction, skip coins that cannot be spent in it: outputs of an unknown witness version, which BIP352 receivers skip, and inputs eligible for the shared secret whose private key the wallet does not have, such as external inputs"

PR commit 2f707ab586: "Fee bumping a silent payments tx by adding inputs needs its original recipients to recompute its outputs. Store them in the wallet database (sprecipients) when the tx is committed"
problem: Bitcoin Core cannot send to BIP 352 silent payment addresses. Because silent payment destinations lack a static scriptPubKey and require dynamic Taproot output derivation from the private keys of the paying transaction's eligible inputs, standard coin selection, destination representations, PSBT signing flows, and transaction fee bumping fail or generate unspendable outputs without dedicated wallet logic.

risk.why: Flaws in silent payment ECDH shared-secret math, input key summation, or output derivation could construct unspendable Taproot scripts or send funds to unintended destinations, causing irreversible loss of user funds.

scope_notes: Spans wallet transaction creation, coin selection, wallet database schema (`sprecipients`), RPC destination validation/parsing, and fee-bumping logic in both the wallet and Qt GUI.
summary: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending to BIP 352 silent payment addresses. It introduces a `PaymentDestination` type spanning standard script destinations and silent payment destinations, selects coins with private keys eligible for BIP 352 ECDH shared secret derivation, dynamically derives Taproot output scripts, and stores recipient destinations in the wallet database to enable RBF fee bumping. RPCs including `send`, `sendtoaddress`, `sendmany`, `sendall`, and `bumpfee` are updated to support silent payments, while incompatible workflows (such as PSBT creation, external signers, and unpersisted wallet transactions) are rejected.
